rationale: The original WBS separates read09.003 from write09.004, TempBuf conversion09.005, masks09.006/007, snapshot09.008, work allocation09.009 and Undo09.011/012. Preserve all 48 source duties unchanged and unfinished; explicitly cross-link their surviving semantics to existing owner tasks, rather than making read depend on its own successors. No requirement is dropped, weakened or marked done by this separation.
